name: anime-reaction-gif
description: Create original anime reaction GIFs from generated pose sheets, expressive key-pose timing, and local FFmpeg assembly with decoded playback proof.

interface.longDescription: Make an original character pose sheet, arrange expressive holds, and export looping GIFs, MP4 previews, and decoded proof. Includes three original examples. The assembler uses Python's standard library and host-installed FFmpeg/ffprobe; creating new poses requires the host's image-generation tool. Key-pose timing is not continuous skeletal animation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create an original anime reaction GIF with distinct poses, expressive timing, a clean loop, and an MP4 preview.
